name: Rubescent-Hamada
description: Cloud-architecture stacks to the horizon in every direction, ammonia cirrus above, sulfurous murk below. Great storm eyes stare up out of the depths, unhurried and permanent.
Every altitude has its own weather opinion, and the hull is the only referee. Mooring in the quiet shear zones is a skill measured in survived seasons.

The terrain around the starship crash site (warship) is scarred for kilometers, and the wreck's black box still loops two seconds of static on an obsolete band. Insurance investigators consider it a haunted assignment.

For traders, helium-3, antimatter traces, exotic matter and fusion fuel alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
